entries.en: will, wish; intention; to be willing (querer)

entries.zh: 我的意愿；随我意、任凭我意（ami voluntad＝照我的意愿）
entries.en: my will; at my will, as I please (a mi voluntad)

entries.zh: 随你意、任凭你意（照你的意愿）
entries.en: at your will, as you please (a tu voluntad)
entries.notes: M 栏尾部 alahua 一词未获切解，不影响主干「随你意」释义。

entries.en: intention of the heart, will; mind
entries.notes: 西语头词 qualquier cota 义不明（疑为讹写）；释义依 H「意心」＝心意与 M 在心立义。

entries.zh: 意向、意向所归（倾心之意愿）；倾向
entries.en: inclination of the will; disposition, bent
satisfied wish, contentment of the will
entries.notes: M 栏 moa 与 17c「滿」(móa) 音相合，H 录作「蒲」疑为形近误读；按 Voluntad satisfecha＝意满释义。

entries.zh: 心满意足、意愿得到满足
entries.en: satisfied wish; contentment (satisfied will)

entries.zh: 尊意（您的心意）；谨遵尊意
entries.en: your (honorific) wish, your honor's pleasure; (headword) voluntarily
entries.notes: 西语头词 voluntariamente（自愿地）与汉文「尊意」（敬称您之意）对应欠吻合，疑头词有讹；释义以尊意为主。

entries.zh: 您、您诸位（第二人称敬称）
entries.en: you (honorific); vosotros, you (plural)
entries.notes: 西语 Votros 疑为 vosotros（你们）；M 栏 un chang 未获切解，释义依 L、H 两栏。

entries.en: you all; all of you (vosotros todos)
entries.notes: H 栏「向」与西语 todos 之对应不明；按 Votros todos＝你们大家释义。

entries.en: vow; to wish, to make a vow (hacer voto)
entries.notes: H 栏存疑（應/慭），M 栏 guan 与「願」相合；按 hacer voto＝许愿、发愿释义。

entries.zh: 下愿、许愿；许下、许诺立誓
entries.en: to make a vow; to promise (prometer), to pledge
to make/utter a vow (dar el voto)
entries.notes: M 栏 hiam 与「發」音不合，疑为讹写或另字；按 dar el voto＝发愿释义。

entries.en: to offer up, present (a vow; an offering)

entries.zh: 奉荐（敬奉献上、奉献愿礼）
entries.en: to offer respectfully, present (a vow)
to offer it up; to present (a vow)
entries.notes: H 栏「奉竟」疑为「奉獻」之误读、M 栏 cu ca li hiam 未获切解，释义存疑。

entries.en: to pray, to wish (a blessing); votive prayer
entries.notes: 西语头词（Voto adorio, salus sanctorum）讹乱；H 栏嘱疑为「祝」，M chioh guan 与「祝愿」相合。

entries.zh: 绝色之愿（戒绝情欲的誓愿；贞洁愿）
entries.en: vow of chastity; renunciation of lust
entries.notes: 「絕色好」末字「好」与戒色语境不合，疑为「慾」等字之讹；按 Voto de castidad＝戒色愿释义。

entries.en: to make a vow, to vow
to promise, to undertake (a vow)
